subject: Q4 GTM capacity request — proposal for 3 quota-bearing roles
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Q4 GTM capacity request — proposal for 3 quota-bearing roles

Hi all,

Requesting approval to convert available budget and one unfilled SDR slot into 3 quota-bearing hires for Q4 to accelerate a few large deals and shore up coverage for the west region:

- 2x Senior Account Executives (individual quota: $1.2M; target OTE: $300k)
  - Proposed base band: $140,000 - $165,000 (Bay Area market adjustment possible)
- 1x Senior Solutions Engineer
  - Proposed base band: $140,000 - $160,000; OTE approx $220k

Rationale:
- Pipeline-led hire: Acme Analytics (DEAL-7843) is in procurement and prefers vendors that can commit to a named AE/SE. This deal alone is forecasted to close $750k ARR in the next 12 months with expansion potential.
- Coverage gap: western accounts are 30% undercovered vs target and we expect churn mitigation + expansion from seat coverage.
- Speed to revenue: With recruiting support and immediate posting, earliest start dates are mid-Jan which still meets customer timeline.

Budget source: reallocate 1 open SDR headcount + 2 slots from the Q4 growth reserve (detailed in attached spreadsheet).

Ask: approval to proceed with offers at the bands above and permission to include a regional market adjustment (Bay Area) where needed. If we can lock approvals by COB Monday (Nov 15) Recruiting can run interviews week of Nov 22 and provide offers by early December.

Attached: 2026_Q4_GTM_hc_sheet.xlsx (budget lines + hires), offer_templates.pdf.

If you want different comp mix (e.g., one mid AE + one senior), I can re-run the cost model quickly.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T10:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q4 GTM capacity request — proposal for 3 quota-bearing roles

Dylan,

Thanks for the write-up — quick clarifying Qs before I sign off:

1) Can you confirm Bay Area market adjustment % you propose? If these roles will be posted hybrid/SF, we should budget +7% on base.
2) Do we have hiring scorecards for the senior AE role (competency + quota plan)?
3) Given the headcount pressure, would you consider 1 senior AE + 1 mid AE + the SE to reduce near-term budget stress?

If you can update the sheet with the adjusted comp lines and a quick hiring scorecard link I’ll take it to Dave for final payroll confirmation.

-Marissa
VP, Sales GTM
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q4 GTM capacity request — proposal for 3 quota-bearing roles

Dylan —

Agree in principle. Couple asks to finalize justification:
- Pipeline coverage: please attach the ACV/ARR forecast by rep for the next 12 months showing where these hires plug in.
- CAC / payback estimate for the new roles (even a high-level 12-month payback is fine).
- Territory alignment doc so we can confirm we are not creating large overlaps.

Also cc'ing Recruiting (Monica) so she can flag constraints on recruiter bandwidth — Monica, FYI: if we approve, how quickly can you post and start screening?

Vivek
Head of Revenue Operations
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-14T11:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q4 GTM capacity request — proposal for 3 quota-bearing roles

Thanks — updated plan below and attached detailed sheet + offer templates.

Comp bands (with Bay Area adjustment where noted):
- Senior AE (x2): base $145,000 - $170,000; OTE $300k. (Bay Area adjustment +7% applied to base for one role slated to cover SF-headquartered accounts.)
- Senior SE (x1): base $142,000 - $158,000; OTE $220k.

Hiring mix (final recommendation): keep 2 senior AEs and 1 SE. I modeled an alternate (1 senior AE + 1 mid AE + SE) in the sheet — cost difference is ~12% but lowers near-term ramp.

Ramp & revenue assumptions (conservative):
- AE ramp to 60% quota in month 6, 90% month 9, full quota month 12.
- Expected incremental ARR from hires in first 12 months: $1.05M (Acme accounted for $750k).
- Estimated 12-month payback: ~9-11 months depending on quota attainment (detailed calc on tab 'payback').

Budget source: 1 unfilled SDR + 2 growth reserve slots (summary tab).

Recruiting timeline (if approved by COB Monday, Nov 15):
- Post JD Nov 17
- First round interviews week of Nov 22
- Onsite / final interviews Dec 1-3
- Offer window Dec 6-10
- Target start mid-Jan 2027

Attachments: 2026_Q4_GTM_hc_sheet.xlsx (tabs: budget, payback, alternate_mix), offer_templates.pdf.

Kendra (Acme) — looping you only so you know we are prioritizing this request to keep the procurement timeline.

Monica — recruiting ask: two AE reqs (SAE) and one SE. Please confirm available recruiters and expected time-to-fill under typical Bay Area market conditions.

Thanks,
Dylan
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q4 GTM capacity request — proposal for 3 quota-bearing roles

Approved as requested with one tweak: for the two Senior AE spots, approve hiring at the midpoint of the band for one role and at the lower-mid for the second (this keeps offer competitiveness while controlling comp run-rate). Bay Area adjustment approved for the SF-assigned AE.

Monica — please post the three reqs today (use the attached templates) and prioritize Acme-facing profiles. Recruiter bandwidth note: if you need an external agency for the SE due to niche skillset, please flag and we'll approve up to 15% agency fee for this hire.

Dylan — proceed with offers once Recruiting confirms candidates and salary bands are applied as above. Keep me looped for any counter-offer situations.

-Lauren
SVP, Go-to-Market Operations
